paragraphs.text: Typed, code-first configuration for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) profiles.
# eedsh
Typed, code-first configuration for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) profiles.
eedsh turns a TypeScript file into a normal DSH profile: ordered bundles, generated patch layers, re
conciled dependencies, and a generation record that `dsh` boots like any other profile. DSH itself i
s untouched; its own patch precedence, plugin manager, and HMR keep working.
## Install
eedsh runs on Node.js >= 26 and needs `pnpm` on `PATH`. DSH is installed separately:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`eedsh init` writes `config.ts`, `package.json`, and `tsconfig.json` under `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eedsh`
(default `~/.config/eedsh`) and installs `@eedsh/config`, its `effect` peer, and TypeScript with pnp
m. It never overwrites existing files, creates no repository, and needs no DSH installation. Add `--
no-install` to write the files and run `pnpm install` yourself.
`eedsh sync`, `eedsh run`, and `eedsh repl` discover exactly one DSH installation per invocation: `-
-dsh <path>`, then `EEDSH_DSH_ANCHOR`, then a `dsh` launcher on `PATH`, then the recorded anchor at
`$DSH_HOME/.local/state/installation.json`, then a project-local `@deepseek-ai/dsh`. The version mus
t satisfy `^0.2.1-rc.2`. When a `PATH` launcher exists but its package cannot be located, `sync` and
the sync step of `run` bootstrap through pnpm or npm global metadata and record the anchor; later c
ommands do not query a package manager. `init --dsh <path>` records an explicit anchor; `init`, `che
ck`, and `doctor --profile` work without any installation.
## Quick start
The config lives at `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/eedsh/config.ts`; eedsh never discovers one in the working dir

[代码示例省略，未执行]
`sync` publishes every profile to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>` (default `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>`); `-
-profile work` narrows it to one. `doctor` and `run` select `--profile`, then `defaultProfile`, then
the sole profile. Working from a checkout? Build it first; see Build from source.
## CLI reference
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- `init` creates the XDG project, never overwrites `config.ts`, `package.json`, or `tsconfig.json`,
and creates no repository. `--no-install` skips pnpm and prints the command. `--dsh <path>` validate
s and records an explicit anchor; without it init reports an existing anchor and never queries pnpm
or npm. Without any installation or anchor, init still succeeds and names the first-sync bootstrap.
- `sync` publishes every profile in record order, or exactly `--profile <name>`, each under a profil
e lock, and installs changed dependencies with pnpm. Invalid, locked, or failed profiles do not stop
valid siblings; the command exits `1` if any selected profile failed. A plan whose layers are uncha
nged but whose generation record names another DSH or eedsh version is republished with refreshed pr
ovenance instead of being skipped, so a manual sync after an upgrade converges without editing `conf
ig.ts`. `--strict` turns preflight warnings into a profile failure. `--watch` re-evaluates the confi
g and selection on every change and keeps the last published generation on failure. `--explain` attr
ibutes each warning to its group, optional label, authoring site, and row ids; it is sync-only. `--a
dopt-ownership` re-baselines ownership only when the generation record is unreadable; it is not for
re-adopting a published removal. `--rebuild` forces every source preparation step; `--no-build` refu

ses to prepare and names the source and commands. The two flags are mutually exclusive.
[该节后续省略]
## Example configuration
This is the canonical reference plan; the test suite pins its canonical JSON and hash. It adds a pro
file-local package and shows the main helpers.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The builders map one-to-one onto Loader patch concepts. `override` replaces a row's whole config; `r
aw` preserves a raw Loader patch entry, including fields the builders do not name. Inserting a resol
ved `Row` or `Preset` normalizes it to its plain Loader row; methods never reach the persisted plan.
| API | Purpose |
| `defineConfig()` | Start the synchronous config builder. `.defaultProfile(name)` and `.profile(nam

e, build)` chain; `.build()` validates. There is no DSH declaration. |
| `dshVersion()` | Return the

exact selected DSH version; throws a tagged `resolution.bridge_missing` outside eedsh. |
| `ConfigB
uilder.build()` | Normalize typed objects, validate the envelope and every profile, and return `Resu

lt<EedshConfig, Schema.SchemaError>`. |
[该节后续省略]
## How it works
### What `eedsh sync` writes
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Publication is atomic and idempotent:
- patch files, the authoritative plan, and the profile manifest are written first; the plan mirror,

provenance sidecar, and generated package manifest are last;
- an unchanged plan with intact artifac
ts changes nothing (same generation id, same bytes) and does not write a sidecar; the next publicati

on repairs a missing one;
- the generation id covers the plan hash and every patch-group hash, so th

e record's `planHash` locates and verifies `plans/<generationId>.json`;
- a stale mirror or missing/
mismatched plan is repaired by the next successful sync with the same generation id, without reinsta

lling;
- a failed install, preflight, mirror write, sidecar write, or commit leaves the previous gen
eration published and restores the manifest, lockfile, mirror, and provenance sidecar.
## Architecture
| Package | Role |
| `@eedsh/plan` | Shared plan contract: Effect Schema, derived plan types, `validatePlan`/`validateC
onfigValue`, the multi-profile envelope, and canonical JSON. Imports Effect only through `effect/Sch

ema` and `effect/Result`, and no Node builtins. |
| `@eedsh/config` | Public typed authoring API: th
e fluent builder, query handles, layer/value builders, `dshVersion()`, and plan normalization. Synch
ronous, no Effect runtime, re-exports plan types only, and reads bundles through the CLI-installed c

apability bridge. |
| `@eedsh/cli` | The `eedsh` command: discovery, config resolution, `init`, tsx
evaluation, selection, `check`, materialization, preflight, atomic publication, watch, and `run`. It
declares no production DSH/app-boot dependency; app-boot comes from the discovered installation. |
| `@eedsh/runtime` | Static DSH bundle and plugin that watches the generation record and reloads thr
ough DSH HMR. Declares `engines.node` and no `engines.dsh`, probes the HMR capabilities it needs, an
d warns on version drift. |
